The recent security halt on Mantra Chain serves as a reminder that infrastructure risks remain despite the broader bull bias. As we approach September ninth when the Treasury doubles long-term debt buyback operations to at least four billion dollars, expect volatility to increase before any potential mean reversion occurs in this overheated environment.

column.text: Bitcoin is currently decoupling from traditional equities as institutional ETF inflows fuel a liquidity-fueled rally rather than pure fundamental expansion. BlackRock absorbed $852 million in BTC and $316 million in ETH over just two days, while stablecoin supply expanded by three billion dollars via Tether and Circle within forty-eight hours. This massive capital entry has pushed Bitcoin to seventy-nine thousand five hundred dollars after a twenty-two percent weekly surge driven by short-covering cascades. Despite extreme overbought conditions with the four-hour RSI exceeding ninety, sustained positive funding rates across major assets combined with expanding open interest in Ethereum and Solana indicate fresh capital rather than leverage recycling. The tape remains up-trending as risk-on sentiment persists even while dollar liquidity contracts against a macro headwind. Retail euphoria is palpable with the Fear & Greed index sitting at seventy-one, yet this divergence between price action and valuation suggests we are entering a phase where demand requires more proof on continuation longs. While Ray Dalio warns of an impending U.S. debt crisis prompting rotations into gold and Bitcoin, short sellers face significant headwinds unless they identify real mechanisms like supply unlocks or failed breakouts rather than simply fading extended moves. The recent security halt on Mantra Chain serves as a reminder that infrastructure risks remain despite the broader bull bias. As we approach September ninth when the Treasury doubles long-term debt buyback operations to at least four billion dollars, expect volatility to increase before any potential mean reversion occurs in this overheated environment.
